body:
# 🌍 ChaosRoulette (Imposter vs Crewmates)

> **[TR]** Bu eklentide Türkçe dil desteği vardır! Komutların yanında Türkçe yamada nasıl çalıştığı belirtilmiştir. 
> *(This plugin officially supports both English and Turkish! Global commands are detailed below with their Turkish equivalents in parentheses).*

---

## 🎮 What is ChaosRoulette?
**ChaosRoulette** brings a fast-paced, "Among Us" inspired minigame directly into your Minecraft server! Every **20 seconds**, the roulette spins and selects one random player to be the **Imposter**, leaving the others as **Crewmates**. 

The Imposter gets powerful weapons and custom potion effects to hunt everyone down, while the Crewmates receive random defensive items to survive the chaos. The last player standing wins!

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions (Komutlar ve Yetkiler)

> ⚠️ **Note:** All commands require **OP (Operator)** status to prevent abuse.
> *(Not: Sabotajı önlemek için tüm komutlar sadece **OP** yetkisi olanlar tarafından kullanılabilir).*

*   **/start (/baslat)**
    *   **Description:** Starts the Chaos Roulette game. Requires at least 2 active players in Survival/Adventure mode.
    *   *(Açıklama: Kaos Ruleti oyununu başlatır. Hayatta kalma modunda en az 2 aktif oyuncu gerektirir).*
*   **/stop (/durdur)**
    *   **Description:** Force-stops the active game immediately and clears all event items from inventories.
    *   *(Açıklama: Aktif oyunu anında durdurur ve tüm etkinlik eşyalarını envanterlerden temizler).*
*   **/restart (/yenidenbaslat)**
    *   **Description:** Completely stops the current loop, resets health/food/inventories of all online players, and starts a fresh new game cleanly.
    *   *(Açıklama: Mevcut döngüyü tamamen durdurur, tüm oyuncuların canını/açlığını/envanterini sıfırlar ve temiz bir şekilde yeni oyunu tetikler).*

---

## ✨ Features (Özellikler)

*   **Anti-Cheat System (Açık Engelleme):** Players cannot drop the given event weapons or defensive items to hoard them for the next round. If a player dies, their event items are automatically vaporized from the drops to prevent illegal looting!
*   **Imposter Category:** The chosen hunter gets a bold custom notification (`You are the IMPOSTER!`), a powerful weapon (Diamond Sword, Diamond Axe, Piercing Crossbow, or Infinity Bow), and a randomized non-lethal sabotage effect (Blindness, Slowness, Strength, Invisibility, etc.). No lethal poison or instant damage—just pure tactical sabotage!
*   **Crewmate Defense:** As soon as an Imposter is chosen, all other innocent players receive one of three random survival utilities: a **Shield**, **6 Steaks**, or **4 Cobwebs** to slow down the killer. All items are auto-cleaned when the 20-second timer rolls over!
*   **Smart Automation:** The game automatically detects if there are not enough players left. If everyone dies or disconnects, the task self-destructs gracefully. When a champion emerges, an interactive clickable `[RESTART GAME]` button appears in chat for OPs to instantly fire up the next round.
